categories_kind.name: categories_kind
categories_kind.value: ("categories"."kind" IN ('income','repayment') AND "categories"."group_id" IS NULL) OR ("categories"."kind"='expense' AND "categories"."group_id" IS NOT NULL)

shares_percent.name: shares_percent
shares_percent.value: "transaction_shares"."percent_bp" IS NULL OR (typeof("transaction_shares"."percent_bp")='integer' AND "transaction_shares"."percent_bp" BETWEEN 1 AND 10000)
